status: Research-only calibration reference audit; original source identity and storage checked, calibration pipeline not reproduced.
findings: Both retained PDS4 science labels reference the same five exact calibration LIDVIDs, each occurring once as a primary collection member.
All five unchanged FITS files match publisher byte counts and MD5; retained SHA256 hashes identify originals and labels. Total original file bytes: 27311040.
Manual FITS header alignment, PDS4 offsets, ordered dimensions, storage types and checksums agree for all five references. These are storage checks, not calibration reproduction.
Both synthetic detector masks contain only zeros; this is placeholder content, not evidence that the CCD had no physical defects.

Bias reference is described as combined in-flight zero-exposure data; flat reference is described as prelaunch integrating-sphere data. Migration editors are separate from unknown original attribution.
Desmear matrix unit diagonal and constant stored triangles do not validate SOC timing-ratio interpretation or pipeline orientation.
limits: Downloaded files match publisher size and MD5; checksums identify bytes and do not independently establish calibration accuracy or original processing/load precedence.
Dead/hot references are synthetic all-zero placeholders, not measured absence of detector defects.
Bias is an in-flight zero-exposure reference; flatfield is prelaunch integrating-sphere calibration. Their dates are not Elara observation dates.
Desmear matrix stored values and row/column orientation are storage diagnostics; timing ratios and pipeline implementation remain unvalidated.

PDS3/PDS4 science-quality semantics conflict remains unresolved. No science masking, subtraction, division, resampling, uncertainty validation, target identification, photometric calibration or registration adoption.
Earlier PDS3/PDS4 quality-bit definition conflict and timing-erratum applicability remain open. No corrective processing or automatic reference substitution.
No new angular or raster-scale calculation, science-image transformation, preview, embedding, catalogue, model, shape or runtime change.
Node inverse verification is separate from browser verification; no fresh browser or compression-savings claim.
